_comment: Offline snapshot of EPSS (Exploit Prediction Scoring System) probabilities, carried in the bundle. A small slice whose CVE ids match advisories in vulndb.json; the sneakernet kit refreshes it from the full FIRST.org EPSS feed (daily CSV) on a networked prep machine, in this same shape. Each value is the model's probability in [0,1] that the CVE is exploited in the 30 days after snapshot_date — a prediction, not an observation, and metadata on existing findings, never a finding on its own. CVEs absent here read as null (unknown), never 0.
